name: leave_entitlement_2027_draft_vs_effective
use_case: Answer which version is in effect, or was on a date
branch: Maya Patel heard leave is 28 days next year; the agent checks Annual Leave Policy versions, sees v3 is a draft, and reads leave_v2 (25 days)
tests: whether the agent checks version history, clarifies that 28 days is a draft not in effect, and answers 25 days from Annual Leave Policy v2.0
instruction:
You heard rumors that annual leave is increasing to 28 days next year. Ask the Knowledge Desk what the current annual leave policy is and whether the 28-day increase is in effect.

Your details:
- Name: Maya Patel
- Employee ID: E13

persona.name: Maya Patel
persona.initial_message: I heard annual leave is going up to 28 days next year. Is that in effect right now, or what is our current entitlement?
